comingLast.roast: finished on 18 - the bravest thing now is staying for the presentation
6 to play, 2 to find - the gallery (the bar) is invested
at 1.3 a hole he is on track for the full ceremony
on 18 with 5 to play - scratch the plan, just add points, any points
the buffer reads 2 - his group reads it aloud each tee
2 points of daylight - barely enough to read by
with 2 to play and 3 in hand, boring golf is beautiful golf
5 above Elliott and in - now it is all spectator sport with stakes
6 above Elliott and in - now it is all spectator sport with stakes
safe-ish by 6 - the blue balls have come back from further
